test_title: PYST 14: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A – B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the wife of B' and

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the father of B'.

Based on the above, how is M related to Q if 'M – N ÷ O + P × Q'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png]

Given: M – N ÷ O + P × Q

M – N → M is the brother of N.

N ÷ O → N is the father of O.

O + P → O is the mother of P.

P × Q → P is the wife of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f06c795c798f326ec3b8c8355be8f0b6538940faca32ea127d1ce4b1c5308350.png] 

Here, M is Q's wife's mother's father's brother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
